Vendored @moonshine-ai/moonshine-wasm 0.1.6 (MIT).
Source: https://github.com/moonshine-ai/moonshine
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@moonshine-ai/moonshine-wasm/v/0.1.6
JavaScript and WASM distribution, without TypeScript declarations/maps.
Only trailing whitespace on a blank generated-module line and in the license was removed.
The oral workshop loads English Small Streaming models from the upstream catalog
on first use and caches them on the device. Audio is processed locally.
Requires cross-origin isolation on the workshop document and its workers.
